evidence: Independently read the full site myself (home + /affiliates.html): this is "Next Level Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Association" (NLBJJA), a global lineage brand founded by Tony Eduardo Hoerhann, headquartered in Sherman, TX. I read the complete affiliates list (15 academies, 9 countries: Brazil x3, USA-TX, USA-NE/Omaha, USA-CA, UK, France, UAE, China x4, Singapore, Australia, India) -- there is no Newfoundland, no Atlantic Canada, and no Canadian affiliate outside Omaha, NE.
